description: The word FILLER as the entry name of a REPORT GROUP description entry (kb/Work PB3964). ANSI X3.23-1985's report group description entry is `level-number [data-name-1]`: an unnamed entry is written by OMITTING the name. ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 53 QUOTES the change: 'FILLER. FILLER is allowed in the report section.' (item 115's bullet: 'FILLER allowed in report section'). The 2023 text is 13.18.20.3 SR3, 'If the entry-name clause is specified in a data description entry or a report group description entry, either data-name-1 or FILLER shall be specified', with 13.18.20.4 GR1 'The word FILLER may be used to name a data, report, or screen item'. FILLER in a data description entry is COBOL-85 and is not gated. Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportGroupEntry, once per written entry.
display: the word FILLER as the entry name of a report group description entry
citation: ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 (substantive changes not affecting existing programs), item 53; ISO §2023:13.18.20.3 SR3, §2023:13.18.20.4 GR1 (2023 text)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RFIL.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "RFIL.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC S9(3) VALUE -5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 PAGE LIMIT IS 10 LINES.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 FILLER COLUMN 1 PIC X(3) VALUE "ABC".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
